description: source_publish.rs:396 publish() walks a whole scope and publishes FunctionSource for EVERY function it defines (publish_function_source per function). One reference into Enum publishes source for all of Enum's functions => 169 cold FunctionSource facts for a program needing 10. Violates 'opening a scope produces no cold function work.' FIX: replace whole-module source publication with demand-addressed publication of the REFERENCED callable, plus module-interface facts only where required for name/protocol lookup (the scope still reserves ids + interface for resolution, but a function's SOURCE/body fact is published only when that function is actually referenced/demanded). Risk: name/protocol/import resolution may rely on eager whole-scope publication - verify resolution still works with interface-only + demand-addressed bodies. Bigger than C1; sequence after it.

comments.text: ATTEMPT 1 (worktree, not landed). Data model PROVEN sound: cold FunctionSource 174->0 (bodies minted only for the 13 reached fns; 178 interfaces stay eager), fixture green, resolution contract holds. Consumer map: name-resolution (resolve_runtime_function / lookup_callable_namespace), protocol dispatch, imports/aliases read INTERFACE only (module_interface, namespace, protocol registration); only ExpandFunctionSource/DefineFunction read the BODY, and they were ALREADY demand-pull (wait on FunctionSource + ensure_function_source). The one body-reader in resolution was the variadic flag in local name scoring -> moved to interface tier. SEAM: scope publication stashes source (stash_function_source + PendingFunctionSourceMap, eager interface), new PULLED Job::PublishFunctionSource(FunctionId) promotes the one stashed body to FunctionSource on demand; ensure_function_source returns it; demand_function_scope demands the owning scope when stash empty (mirror DeriveTypeDef pull). BUT 12 NEW reds (all green at baseline): (1) scheduler WAKE-UP - a parked PublishFunctionSource isn't woken when its scope is walked late (old ScopeCode OUTPUT FunctionSource, now it doesn't); fixable with a precise wait on scope/ModuleDefined. (2) FRONTIER RETRACTION / CONVERGENCE - redefining_main doesn't retract old frontier; quicksort settles on 3 partition/4 activations not 1 = the latent NON-MONOTONICITY (body-availability timing perturbs the join order, exposing the same bug behind 00420). (3) NATIVE-BOUNDARY conflation - publication ordering -> 'matched multiple native boundaries' for protocol-callback FunctionId(160) = the same multiple-native-boundary bug as 00420's Fatal LowerNativeProgram. CONCLUSION: C2's data model is right but it is BLOCKED by the convergence non-monotonicity (C3 territory, fz-f98.14.1) and the native-boundary conflation. Family-1 (wake) is C2-local + fixable. Resume C2 AFTER those land.

title: Demand-addressed FunctionSource publication: no cold whole-scope source facts
